title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
ii.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
iii.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
iv.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
v.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
colophon: drift and pull; a field that never settles the same way twice.
